description: This file defines a serializer class 'VersionCodec' for serializing and deserializing the 'Version' type, along with a surrogate struct 'VersionSurrogate' used during serialization. It includes methods for converting between 'Version' and its surrogate representation, and references external serializer interfaces.

classes.name: VersionCodec
classes.description: A sealed class that serializes and deserializes the 'Version' type using surrogate serialization.

classes.name: VersionSurrogate
classes.description: A struct used as a surrogate for the 'Version' class during serialization, containing major, minor, build, and revision components.

methods.name: VersionCodec
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the codec with a surrogate serializer.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a 'Version' object to its surrogate representation.
